data.name: Hyper Glee Semik
data.detailed_description:
Tired of demons, blood, and gore? It’s time to face your childhood treats! Your favorite sweets have been brought to life by the twisted mad scientist, Small Doc. Get ready for a sugar rush that might actually kill you.

The Glycolysator, Diabetes, and Candy

Hyper Glee Semik is a high-octane First-Person Shooter centered around the mechanics of diabetes. Play as Glee, blast through waves of sentient confectionery, and take your revenge in a rain of sugar.

A Fast-Paced, Merciless Romp

Keep moving! Destroy the storage vats before you are overwhelmed by hordes of candies, more aggressive than ever. Fight your way out of the laboratory before it's too late.

Keep Your Gauge Stable

Watch your gauge! Your survival hangs by a thread. Don't flirt with the maximum or you’ll face instant death, and avoid the minimum at all costs to escape debilitating side effects. To stay in the safety zone, blast your enemies, collect their orbs, and maintain the perfect balance to keep the fight going.

Colorful and Crazed Art Style

Dive into a unique 2.5D universe that blends a Comic Book aesthetic with a "cute but cruel" world. It’s a striking visual contrast designed for nervous gameplay.

Features:

  • Challenging Gameplay: A shooter where resource management is just as vital as your aim.

  • Hybrid Visuals: A unique art style mixing "cute" charm with comic vibes in a 2.5D universe.

  • Initial Content: 3 levels and 2 types of enemies.

  • One Weapon: The Glycolysator.

------------------------------------

Hyper Glee Semik is a Final Year Project created by the Class of 2026 at Brassart Montpellier, produced over 5 months.

Developed with Unity.

data.short_description: Hyper Glee Semik is a first-person shooter where you play as Glee, a teenage girl who has to survive a horde of candies. Keep the pace, and shoot them all!
